title: Mantine registry
description: Authoring format for a Mantine component registry. Compiled to the interchange wire format by tools/build-registry.

namespace.description: Namespace consumers register this registry under. Used to qualify `uses` entries at build time.

kind.description: What this item is, in Mantine terms.

mantine.description: Semver range the item's source requires. Checked against the project's installed @mantine/core — a gate, not an install directive.

provider.description: Item only works inside a MantineProvider. The client verifies one exists and offers to add it.

uses.description: Other items this one needs. Bare names resolve within this registry; `@other/name` crosses registries.

target.description: Explicit destination. Omit to let the client place it by `as`.

themeFragment.description: Path to a theme module merged into the project theme on install, rather than written as a file.

stylesApi.description: Styles API selectors this item exposes, keyed by component name.
